div.p: This tool is designed for developers to inspect public TikTok video links and test API integrations for educational purposes.
We respect your privacy. TeaHack TikTok Toolkit does not collect, store, or share any personal user data. All operations run locally or interact securely with official endpoints where applicable.
By using this tool, you agree to use it only for testing, educational, and development purposes in compliance with TikTok's Developer Terms of Service.
For any questions, you can reach out via our GitHub repository.
